verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm custom fonts/themes (including bundled Pragmata Pro), an Appearance settings section for styling terminal with themes and fonts, and keyboard/cursor-related customization, implying persistent settings tied to the app config. missing for 10: no explicit mention of cursor style/shape customization, no independent/hands-on confirmation that settings persist across sessions or devices, and community asks about syncing settings across devices suggest persistence may be local-only.
